custom_logic_notes: The 2pbIdealXOSMA custom indicator is a triple-ideal-moving-average oscillator with OSMMA smoothing. It uses three pairs of rough+adjusting smoothing periods (X, Y, Z) plus two additional smoothing periods (Period1, Period2). The entry logic compares three consecutive histogram values: when histogram is declining (macd[1]<macd[2]) and current bar turns up (macd[0]>macd[1]), it generates a buy signal; conversely for sell. The CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh supports 10 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) and is used for additional smoothing of the histogram output. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides the BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with position gating and signal-time tracking.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement 2pbIdealXOSMA indicator in Python - it is a triple-ideal-MA oscillator with 8 smoothing period parameters plus an additional XMA smoothing pass (JJMA with period=9, phase=100). The JJMA (JMA) algorithm is proprietary and needs an open-source approximation. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions must be replaced with simple market order logic. Signal logic is straightforward: 3-bar histogram comparison (declining-then-rising = buy, rising-then-declining = sell). Entry is gated by new bar detection and buy/sell permission flags. Stop loss/take profit are simple fixed-point values. Position sizing uses a dual-mode input (negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit fraction).
